title: Purification, characterization and functional site prediction of the vaccinia-related kinase 2A small transmembrane domain
author: Puja, Chakraborty, et al.

steps.title: Retrieve models and blind docking
steps.instruction: Download the AlphaFold predicted structures VRK2 (AF‑Q86Y07‑F1) and TAK1 (AF‑O43318‑F1) and perform blind protein‑protein docking using Bioluminate (PIPER) to generate 45 583 poses.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve AlphaFold models from the AlphaFold database.
Load both models into Bioluminate (Schrödinger, LLC).
Run blind docking with the PIPER algorithm, requesting 45 583 output structures.

steps.title: Cluster and rank docked poses
steps.instruction: Cluster the 45 583 docking structures into 120 poses based on electrostatic, hydrophobic and van‑der‑Waals interactions and rank them by cluster size.

substeps.instruction: Use Bioluminate’s clustering tool to group the poses into 120 clusters.
Rank clusters by the number of members (cluster size).

steps.title: Calculate binding energies
steps.instruction: Select the top five largest clusters and evaluate their binding free energies and Kd values with Prime MM‑GBSA.

substeps.instruction: Take the representative pose from each of the five largest clusters.
Run Prime MM‑GBSA (Schrödinger) on each pose to obtain ΔG and estimated Kd.
Choose the complex with the best (most negative) docking score for further analysis.

steps.title: Prepare MD simulation system
steps.instruction: Set up the chosen VRK2A‑TAK1 complex for molecular dynamics using Desmond with the OPLS3e force field.

substeps.instruction: Generate topology and parameter files with OPLS3e.
Place the protein in a cubic TIP3P water box leaving at least 10 Å to the box edge.
Add counter‑ions to neutralize the system.

steps.title: Energy‑minimize and equilibrate
steps.instruction: Energy‑minimize the system for 5 000 ps using the conjugate‑gradient algorithm, then equilibrate under NVT and NPT ensembles with restraints.

substeps.instruction: Minimization: 5 000 ps, conjugate‑gradient.
NVT restrained: 24 ps followed by 2 000 ps.
NPT restrained: 24 ps, then NPT unrestrained: 5 000 ps.
Apply LINCS constraints to all bonds during equilibration.

steps.title: Run production MD
steps.instruction: Perform a 200 ns unrestrained NPT simulation, saving coordinates every 10 ps to generate 20 000 frames for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Run Desmond at constant pressure and temperature (no restraints).
Write trajectory snapshots at 10 ps intervals.

steps.title: Analyse MD clusters
steps.instruction: Cluster the 20 000 frames, identify H‑bonding residues with PDBsum, and compute the percentage survival index (PSI) for each interaction.

substeps.instruction: Cluster trajectories (10 ps interval) using the built‑in Desmond clustering tool.
For each cluster representative, run PDBsum to list H‑bonds, salt‑bridges and non‑bonded contacts.
Calculate PSI = (number of frames showing a given interaction) / 20 000 × 100 %.

steps.title: Construct full‑length VRK2A plasmid
steps.instruction: Clone VRK2A (aa 1‑508, 1 532 bp) from Addgene (pDONR223) into pGEX‑4T vector using BamHI and HindIII, verify by restriction digest and sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Obtain pDONR223‑VRK2A (Addgene).
Digest VRK2A insert and pGEX‑4T vector with BamHI and HindIII.
Ligate insert into vector, transform, and screen colonies.
Confirm correct construct by restriction analysis and Sanger sequencing.

steps.title: Transform and grow Rosetta cells
steps.instruction: Introduce pGEX‑4T‑VRK2A into Rosetta pLysS (Novagen) cells, grow a 5 ml LB starter with ampicillin (100 µg/ml) and chloramphenicol (34 µg/ml) at 37 °C for 18 h.

substeps.instruction: Electroporate or chemically transform Rosetta pLysS cells.
Plate on LB‑agar containing ampicillin and chloramphenicol.
Pick a single colony to inoculate 5 ml LB with the same antibiotics; incubate 18 h, 37 °C, shaking.

steps.title: Scale‑up expression culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 700 ml pre‑warmed LB (ampicillin + chloramphenicol) in a 2 L flask, grow at 37 °C, 180 rpm to OD₆₀₀ = 0.5.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 ml starter to 700 ml media.
Monitor OD₆₀₀; when it reaches 0.5, proceed to induction.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Add IPTG to a final concentration of 0.1 mM, shift temperature to 14 °C and incubate 4–12 h.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1 M IPTG stock; add 0.7 ml to 700 ml culture.
Cool shaker to 14 °C, continue shaking for the desired time.

steps.title: Prepare samples for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Collect 1 ml aliquots of uninduced and induced cultures, add 6× SDS Laemmli buffer, sonicate induced cells for 12 h sample, centrifuge and keep supernatant for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Mix cell pellets with 6× Laemmli buffer (final 1×).
Sonicate induced cells (e.g., 3 × 30 s on/off).
Centrifuge at 13 000 rpm, 4 °C, 10 min; load supernatant on 12 % SDS‑PAGE.

steps.title: Western blot verification
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins from 12 % SDS‑PAGE to a PVDF membrane pre‑equilibrated in 50 mM Tris‑Cl, 150 mM NaCl (TBS), block with 5 % BSA 1 h, probe with anti‑GST (1:2000) then anti‑rabbit HRP (1:10 000), wash with 0.1 % Tween‑20/TBS, develop with SuperSignal™ West Pico.

substeps.instruction: Transfer at 100 V for 1 h.
Block 1 h at room temperature in 5 % BSA/TBS.
Incubate with primary anti‑GST (1:2000) 1 h.
Wash 3 × 5 min with 0.1 % Tween‑20/TBS.
Incubate with HRP‑conjugated anti‑rabbit (1:10 000) 1 h.
Wash as above and add chemiluminescent substrate.

steps.title: GST‑VRK2A affinity purification
steps.instruction: Lyse induced cells by sonication (3 × 30 s on/off) in ice‑cold lysis buffer (20 mM Na₂HPO₄/NaH₂PO₄, 100 mM NaCl, pH 7.0 PBS, 0.2 % Triton X‑100, protease inhibitor 1:50, 5 mM β‑mercaptoethanol), centrifuge 22 000 rpm, 4 °C, 30 min, incubate supernatant with 5 column volumes pre‑equilibrated GST‑Sepharose for 1 h at 4 °C, wash 5 column volumes PBS, elute with PBS containing 15 mM reduced glutathione, analyse eluates on 12 % SDS‑PAGE.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate lysate as described.
Centrifuge and collect supernatant.
Add GST‑Sepharose resin (pre‑equilibrated with 5 CV PBS).
Rotate 1 h at 4 °C.
Wash resin with 5 CV PBS.
Elute bound protein with PBS + 15 mM reduced glutathione.

steps.title: In‑gel digestion for mass spectrometry
steps.instruction: Excise the three upper VRK2A bands from the 12 % SDS‑PAGE, mince, dehydrate twice with 100 µl acetonitrile, re‑hydrate with 50 µl 5 ng/µl modified trypsin in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate, incubate on ice 40 min, add 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and incubate 37 °C overnight.

substeps.instruction: Transfer gel pieces to microcentrifuge tubes.
Wash with 100 µl ACN, centrifuge, discard supernatant; repeat.
Add trypsin solution, ice 40 min.
Add 50 mM NH₄HCO₃, incubate 16–18 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Peptide extraction and MALDI‑TOF/TOF
steps.instruction: Extract peptides with 50 µl 0.1 % formic acid/water, then three times with 50 µl 0.1 % formic acid/50 % acetonitrile, dry, spot on MALDI plate and acquire spectra on Ultraflex II MALDI‑TOF/TOF; identify by Mascot against SwissProt.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge gel pieces, collect supernatant.
Perform three extractions as described.
Pool extracts, dry in a SpeedVac.
Resuspend in matrix solution, spot, acquire spectra.
Search spectra with Mascot (Matrix Sciences) against human SwissProt.

steps.title: Construct VTMD (aa 480‑508) plasmid
steps.instruction: Introduce a second BamHI site after residue 479 in pGEX‑4T‑VRK2A by site‑directed mutagenesis PCR, digest with BamHI, gel‑extract the 5 043 bp fragment (pGEX4T‑HindIII‑VRK2A‑480‑508‑BamHI) and self‑ligate to generate the VTMD clone.

substeps.instruction: Perform PCR with primers adding BamHI after 479.
Digest PCR product and vector with BamHI.
Run 1 % agarose gel; excise the 5 043 bp band.
Purify gel slice, ligate (T4 DNA ligase) and transform.
Screen colonies by restriction analysis.

steps.title: Express GST‑VTMD
steps.instruction: Transform Rosetta pLysS cells with the VTMD construct, grow and induce exactly as for full‑length VRK2A (0.1 mM IPTG, 14 °C, 4–12 h).

substeps.instruction: Follow steps 5‑8 using the VTMD plasmid.

steps.title: Purify GST‑VTMD
steps.instruction: Lyse cells (10 × 30 s sonication) in PBS + 0.2 % Triton X‑100, protease inhibitor 1:50, 5 mM β‑mercaptoethanol, centrifuge, bind supernatant to GST‑Sepharose (5 CV) for 1 h at 4 °C, wash with PBS, elute with PBS + 15 mM reduced glutathione; verify 29.7 kDa band on 12 % SDS‑PAGE.

substeps.instruction: Sonication as described (10 cycles).
Centrifuge 22 000 rpm, 4 °C, 30 min.
Incubate with resin, wash, elute.

steps.title: Thrombin cleavage of GST tag
steps.instruction: Dialyze pooled GST‑VTMD eluate against PBS (3 column volumes), add 100 µl thrombin (100 NIH units) to 16 ml protein solution (~2 mg total), incubate 20 °C for 16 h.

substeps.instruction: Dialysis: 3 × PBS exchanges, 4 °C.
Add thrombin (100 µl, 100 NIH units).
Incubate 16 h at 20 °C.

steps.title: Remove GST and thrombin
steps.instruction: Pass the cleavage mixture through a fresh GST‑Sepharose column; collect flow‑through (FT) containing VTMD and thrombin, wash column with PBS, elute bound GST with 15 mM reduced glutathione.

substeps.instruction: Load cleavage mixture onto GST resin pre‑equilibrated with PBS.
Collect FT (VTMD + thrombin).
Wash resin with PBS, elute GST with glutathione.

steps.title: Centrifugal filtration of VTMD
steps.instruction: First filter the FT through a 10 kDa MWCO Centricon (pre‑equilibrated with 10 ml PBS) to retain thrombin (36 kDa) and collect 8 ml flow‑through containing VTMD at 0.06 mg/ml (13.5 µM); then concentrate the VTMD using a 1 kDa MWCO Centricon to 24 µM.

substeps.instruction: Load FT onto 10 kDa filter, centrifuge as per manufacturer’s protocol.
Collect filtrate (VTMD).
Transfer filtrate to 1 kDa filter, spin to desired volume, measure concentration.

steps.title: Analyze VTMD by Tris‑Tricine SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Run all fractions (uncut GVTMD, cleaved VTMD, FT, concentrated VTMD) on 15 % Tris‑Tricine gels at 4 °C (anode 2.1 M Tris, cathode 1 M Tris + 1 M Tricine), stain with silver ammonia method.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 15 % Tris‑Tricine gel, pre‑run at 4 °C.
Load samples, run electrophoresis.
Fix gels 50 % methanol 3 h, wash 3 × 10 min with autoclaved water.
Prepare staining solution: 48 ml solution A (10 M NaOH + 700 µl NH₃ in water) titrated with 2 ml solution B (20 % AgNO₃).
Incubate gels 20 min on rocker, wash 2 × 15 min with water.
Develop with 1 % citric acid + 38 % formaldehyde, monitor band appearance.
Stop reaction with 40 % methanol + 1 % acetic acid.

steps.title: Thermal stability CD measurement
steps.instruction: Measure far‑UV CD at 208 nm for 17.5 µM GVTMD, VTMD and GST‑only in PBS pH 7.0 while increasing temperature from 20 °C to 90 °C; record mean residual ellipticity to determine melting temperatures (Tm ≈ 64 °C for GVTMD, 55 °C for GST, 54 °C for VTMD).

substeps.instruction: Prepare each protein at 17.5 µM in PBS pH 7.0.
Load into CD cuvette, set wavelength 208 nm.
Ramp temperature 20 → 90 °C, record ellipticity at each point.

steps.title: Intrinsic fluorescence spectroscopy
steps.instruction: Record emission spectra (300‑400 nm) of 17.5 µM protein solutions (GVTMD, VTMD, GST) in PBS pH 7.0 at 25 °C with excitation at 275 nm, both in native buffer and after addition of 6 M urea; use 5 nm excitation and emission slits.

substeps.instruction: Prepare protein samples (17.5 µM) in quartz cuvette (1 mm path).
Measure native spectra (excite 275 nm, record 300‑400 nm).
Add 6 M urea, incubate briefly, repeat measurement.
Note λmax shifts (≈ 339 nm native, 347‑354 nm with urea).

steps.title: Surface hydrophobicity ANS assay
steps.instruction: Add ANS to each protein sample (17.5 µM in PBS pH 7.0, final ANS 10 µM), incubate 60 min at 25 °C, record fluorescence emission 450‑550 nm with excitation at 390 nm (5 nm slits, 0.5 nm resolution).

substeps.instruction: Prepare protein solutions at 0.05 mg/ml (≈ 17.5 µM).
Add ANS to 10 µM final concentration.
Incubate 60 min at 25 °C.
Measure emission spectrum as described.
